scope: Historical mainnet Script replay with supplied undo, plus complete in-memory regtest and early-mainnet replay. One script thread. Not full mainnet IBD.
source_revision_note: The repository changed concurrently. The copied-workspace build revision and staged source hashes identify the executable; the later run Git HEAD is not its build revision.

run.scope: single-thread isolated replay; historical scripts use supplied undo; complete test-chain replay derives state

build.scope: single-thread isolated replay; historical scripts use supplied undo; complete test-chain replay derives state

corpus.scope: actual mainnet blocks with locally supplied undo/prestate; not genesis replay

additional_recovery_timing_scope: Correctness-only checks ran alongside compilation/sanitizer tests; their wall timings are not controlled performance samples.

unsuccessful_attempts.reason: Sorted records in one physical block file were not contiguous. Extraction stopped; the corrected extractor selects a linked run and verifies undo associations.
